sources.entry: Couleurs - Simple app for grabbing and tweaking the colors you see on your screen. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Couleurs
summary.one_liner: Couleurs is a simple macOS app for picking colors from anywhere on screen and copying them in common formats such as CSS hex and Swift UIColor.
use_cases: Grab a color from anything on screen
Copy a CSS hex value for a web design
Get a UIColor value for Swift iOS code
Paste a CSS color to inspect it
Tweak colors picked from the screen
summary.what_it_does: Couleurs uses Apple's color panel, including its magnifying glass, to sample colors displayed on screen. It offers a quick way to copy color values to the clipboard in common formats, including CSS formats like #rrggbb and UIColor values in Swift. Pressing ⌘C copies the selected color to the clipboard. Pressing ⌘V while the app is active lets you paste in any CSS color value.
notable: Built on Apple's native color panel with magnifying glass
Copies colors as CSS hex and Swift UIColor values
caveats: The page does not state other platforms or version details
